import csv
from datetime import date, timedelta
from collections import defaultdict

rooms = defaultdict(list)
with open("дані/бронювання.csv", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        room = row["кімната"].strip()
        a = date.fromisoformat(row["з"].strip())
        b = date.fromisoformat(row["по"].strip())
        if b < a:
            a, b = b, a
        rooms[room].append((a, b))

one = timedelta(days=1)
for room in sorted(rooms):
    merged = []
    for a, b in sorted(rooms[room]):
        if merged and a <= merged[-1][1] + one:
            if b > merged[-1][1]:
                merged[-1][1] = b
        else:
            merged.append([a, b])
    total = sum((b - a).days + 1 for a, b in merged)
    parts = ", ".join(f"{a.isoformat()}..{b.isoformat()}" for a, b in merged)
    print(f"{room}: {parts} ({total} днів)")
